title: Say on the turn when a recognised test command ran through an unrecorded route (Claude's PowerShell tool), instead of staying silent
outcome: A Claude session that runs a recognised test or launcher command through a route TermAl does not record gets a host line on that turn naming the route and the recorded form, so it never waits for a credit that cannot come.
acceptance: When a Claude session runs a command TermAl would recognise as a test or launcher run (including a detached full launch) through its PowerShell tool, the host adds a line on that turn stating that the run is not recorded and giving the recorded form (`pushd "DIR" && <test>` through the Bash tool).

A test drives a PowerShell-tool command carrying a recognised launcher line and asserts the host line appears and no check or carried launch is registered; a control drives the same line through the Bash tool and asserts the run is registered with no such line.
Commands that are not recognised test or launcher runs, run through PowerShell, produce no such line.
